'''Taffy''' was a type of sticky [[Candy/Legends|candy]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], it was sold at [[Mooth's trading post]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. When a group of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] came to buy items from the store, one of them, [[Widdle Warrick/Legends|Widdle Warrick]], attempted to convince [[Gender/Legends|his]] brother, [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]], to purchase some of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|taffy]]. In that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Wicket's friend, [[Teebo]], made a [[Color/Legends|pink]] variant, [[sugar leaf taffy]], from pebbles by using his [[Magic/Legends|magic]].

==Description==
Taffy was a type of sticky, [[Color/Legends|beige]] [[Candy/Legends|candy]] that could be eaten by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].<ref name="Curse" /> A pink variant, [[sugar leaf taffy]], could be made from pebbles via [[Magic/Legends|magic]].<ref name="Hut" />

==History==
Taffy was sold at [[Mooth's trading post]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]<ref name="Curse" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] animated series, which include the appearance of [[Foodstuff/Legends|taffy]] in "[[Horville's Hut of Horrors (episode)|Horville's Hut of Horrors]]" and "[[The Curse of the Jindas]]," to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> when several Ewoks visited the store. Prior to the owner, [[Mooth]], coming out to greet them, one of the young Ewoks, [[Widdle Warrick/Legends|Widdle Warrick]], stirred a pot of taffy [[Gender/Legends|he]] found, attempting to convince his brother, [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]], to purchase some. As Wicket pondered his decision on what to purchase, Widdle continued to try to persuade him to choose the taffy, as he [[Diet/Legends|ate]] some of it and got stuck in it himself. Ultimately, Wicket chose to purchase a rock.<ref name="Curse" />

Wicket Warrick's friend [[Teebo]] made [[Sugar/Legends|sugar]] leaf taffy<ref name="Hut" /> also in 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="Date note" /> when the two of them were trying to get several [[Wokling/Legends|wokling]] Ewoks to stop crying after their visit to the [[Horville's Hut of Horrors]] attraction, which greatly scared them. Teebo used his magic to inflate several pebbles until they exploded, causing himself to be covered in the taffy, which the woklings found to be humorous.<ref name="Hut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Taffy first appeared in "[[The Curse of the Jindas]],"<ref name="Curse" /> the seventh episode in the [[Ewoks: Season One|first season]] of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']], which was released [[October 19]], [[1985]].<ref name="TV">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
